title: fix(spec): register the upgrade-guide entry for the flow by-name reads the flow-per-namespace change narrowed

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg7hU4nqZzq4X97nuFabGxKv)_
epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYAGCZcafN5hk3uj4u

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：给 flow 按命名空间分包（#32507，已合入）声明的收窄补一条 ADR-0087 语义迁移条目 `flow-by-name-read-shared-or-unreachable-refused`，并把那张 changeset 的 `adr-0087:` 标记从 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` 改为 `registered`。
- 为什么改：#32649 起，声明 `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` 的 changeset 不能再用这个豁免；#32507 在它合入后紧接着进了 main，欠一条升级指南条目。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个条目文件和一张 spec patch changeset，不动 schema、导出和运行时。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-by-name-read-shared-or-unreachable-refused.ts`。
- 需要你做的：无，专题席位落地。

Refs #31696

## What changes

- **One semantic migration entry** in protocol 18's step of the upgrade guide and `os migrate meta`: `flow-by-name-read-shared-or-unreachable-refused` (`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`). It names the two by-name flow reads the flow-per-namespace change refuses: (1) a bare read of a name two packages of two namespaces hold (`GET /api/v1/meta/flow/NAME`, `MetadataManager` for type flow with no package) answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both, where it served the first registered; (2) a package's by-name read of a flow only the environment holds, or one a package outside its declared dependencies holds, is refused naming the holders (ADR-0150 D3). Replacement: read by package (`?package=ID`, `/api/v1/meta/flow/NS/NAME`), declare a dependency on the shipping package (ADR-0141), or ship the flow in the reading package. Acceptance: every bare-name caller finds one holder or moves to the qualified read; every package's by-name read reaches its flow.
- **`.changeset/31696-flow-names-per-namespace.md`**: its marker now reads `<!-- adr-0087: registered flow-by-name-read-shared-or-unreachable-refused -->`. Nothing else in it moves (a DELIBERATE CORRECTION of a pending note, declared below).
- **`.changeset/31696-flow-by-name-read-upgrade-guide-entry.md`** (new): `@objectstack/spec` patch for the entry, as the flow refusal entries before it shipped.

## DELIBERATE CORRECTION

`Check Changeset` refuses this PR because it edits a pending changeset that is on the merge base: `.changeset/31696-flow-names-per-namespace.md` (the flow-per-namespace release note, merged in #32507). That is deliberate, not a filename collision: the note's ADR-0087 disposition said no ledger entry was owed, and this PR adds the entry, so the old disposition is now false. Only that one line changes; no rendered sentence of the note moves.

- **Before** (merge base 9cd5fc161):

  ```
  <!-- adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) no key of any schema is added, removed, renamed or re-shaped and no stored row changes shape: what moves is which flow a by-name read, an address, an action or an endpoint answers, and which second package an install admits; the stored metadata and the activation ledger are read exactly as before, so there is nothing for `objectstack migrate meta` to rewrite -->
  ```

- **After** (head 418f091ed):

  ```
  <!-- adr-0087: registered flow-by-name-read-shared-or-unreachable-refused -->
  ```

Restoring the line from the base would put the false disposition back. Confirmed by the dispatching seat's record (its same-head contract review), per pm-dispatch `references/landing-operations.md`.

## Why

#32649 (merged 09:23Z) refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on a changeset that declares `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`: a narrowing owes the upgrade guide an entry. The flow-per-namespace PR merged at 09:45Z with that exemption, so its entry is owed here.

## Verification

- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. On the flow-per-namespace branch merged with `main` a8c761fbe, before this fix, it exited 1 naming that changeset; with the entry and the marker it exited 0 (`registered … (new here: flow-by-name-read-shared-or-unreachable-refused)`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:migration-registry`: exit 0 (569 semantic entries). Spec migration tests (`vitest run --project local src/migrations/`): 5 files, 198 tests passed. eslint on the entry: exit 0.

Metadata-protocol: none
